# Knowledge as code

`Glossary: gls-knowledge-as-code` `DRAFT`

The framework's own vocabulary. Every corpus shares it, so it is held to naming a type rather than linking to one — and
it is a record as well, which is the pair of passes this file is here to separate.

## Scope

[ADRs](/adrs.md) is reported once, for naming a type. [A page that does not exist](/nope.md) is reported once and not
twice: a record has already had the link pass, so the framework pass leaves it alone.

## Terms

### Term

A definition, so the section is not empty.
